desc:
[DOUBLE EXP WEEKEND] 

Lantern's Universe is an open world, superhero and PvP-based adventure that immerses you in epic galactic battles and exploration. Explore various planets and space sectors with their own uniqueness.

💫Harness the power of different emotions across the spectrum of electromagnetic light.
🤝 Team up with friends or explore the universe solo.
🦾 Unlock all types of gear and accessories to customize your hero.
⚔️ Fight other heroes or villains in fast-paced, high-action battles that span the cosmos.

Dominate or save the worlds around you.
The choice is yours.

Mobile, Tablet, PC, and Console supported.
